title: Fleet and drivers
intro: Vehicles and drivers used on the electronic manifest (MDF-e) and, later on, on the tracking app.
readOnly: You are not allowed to manage the fleet
vehiclesEmptyHint: Register the plate, the capacity and the owner of each vehicle — that is what the MDF-e and the freight calculation read.
driversEmptyHint: Register the tax id and the license of each driver to issue the manifest and grant access to the app.
filtersEmptyHint: Adjust the search fields or clear the filters to see the full list.
invalidDraft: There are invalid fields in the form
versionConflict: The record changed in another session. Reload the page before saving.
plateTaken: A vehicle with this plate already exists
taxIdTaken: A driver with this tax id already exists
membershipTaken: This user is already linked to another driver
membershipNotFound: User not found in this company
emailTaken: Another user already uses this e-mail
contactRequired: Provide an e-mail or a phone number to send the invitation
driverNotFound: Driver not found in this company
vehicleTypeRequiredHint: Without the vehicle type, the MDF-e cannot be issued and the freight table cannot tell which column pays this vehicle.
vehicleTypeHint: It decides the freight table column and the MDF-e wheel type.
brandCatalogVehicleTypeHint: Pick the vehicle type in the identification block to load the brands.
brandCatalogUnavailableHint: Brand catalog is unavailable right now. Type the brand as printed on the CRLV.
fleetNumberHint: Carrier internal numbering. Sent in the MDF-e when filled in.
vehicleOwnerHint: Required for aggregate or third-party vehicles — it fills the MDF-e owner group.
ownerDriverPickerPlaceholder: Search driver by name or tax id
ownerDriverPickerSearchPlaceholder: Type the name or tax id
ownerDriverPickerHint: Pick the driver who owns the vehicle: the owner data comes from their record. Register them here when they are not on file yet.
ownerDriverEditHint: Fix the aggregate driver record without leaving the vehicle form.
ownerDriverCreateHint: Fill in the driver's data to use them as this vehicle's owner.
vehicleCostHint: Values used in freight pricing. Leave blank whatever the carrier has not measured yet — no field is required.
driverLinkedTaxIdHint: Company tax id of the self-employed driver, used for invoicing. The MDF-e driver is still the personal tax id — leave it empty when the driver works as an individual only.
driverEmailHint: The driver address used to sign in on the delivery app. The invitation goes out by e-mail or by phone: either one is enough.
driverAnttHint: The driver ANTT registration and category. When the vehicle is theirs, this is what goes in the MDF-e owner group.
driverProfileHint: Registering a driver already creates their user for the delivery app. An aggregate usually drives their own vehicle; a driver takes their own or the carrier's.
driverFirstLicenseAtHint: The day the driver was first licensed, as printed on the licence. It is kept for reference.
driverLicenseExpiresAtHint: The date the license expires. It stays on the record for lookup — the automatic expiry warning does not exist yet.

identityDocumentIssuerOption.SJS: SJS — State justice and safety department

driverPersonalHint: Nationality, place of birth, parents, identity document and the licence issuing place are kept on the record for reference — no fiscal document carries them today.
driverLinkedAddressHint: Address of the linked company. Start with the postal code: it fills the address in and leaves only the number to type.
driverAddressHint: Start with the postal code: it fills the address in and leaves only the number to type. Without one at hand, search by address in the field beside it and pick from the list.
driverAddressPostalCodeHint: Eight digits. The lookup fires on its own once complete.
driverAddressSearchHint: Street, city — the list shows up as you type.
driverAddressCityStateFirst: Pick the state to list its cities.
addressSearchEmpty: No address found for this text.
addressLookupFound: Address filled in from the postal code. Check the number and the complement.
addressLookupMissing: Postal code not found. Fill the address in by hand or use the search.
companyLookupPending: Looking up the company tax id…
companyLookupFound: Legal name filled in from the tax id. Check it before saving.
companyLookupMissing: Tax id not found in the public registry. Type the legal name.
licenseNumberTaken: Another driver in this company already uses this license number.
driverVehiclesHint: Pick the vehicles this driver operates — both their own and the carrier ones. The link keeps history: removing closes the period instead of erasing the past.
driverVehiclesEmpty: No active vehicle available to link

driverCoverage.hint: Add the whole zone when the driver runs the entire route, or pick single cities when they cover only part of it. The whole zone replaces the loose cities of that route.
driverCoverage.citiesEmpty: This route has no city registered
driverCoverage.empty: No region picked — the driver has no coverage.

vehicleNotFound: One of the selected vehicles no longer exists in this company

fuelPrices.title: Fuel price
fuelPrices.hint: Cost per kilometre comes from this price divided by the vehicle's average consumption. Without an adjustment the public reference applies — ANP for fuels, ANEEL for electricity; the value typed here replaces it until cleared.
fuelPrices.unavailable: No price in use. Without an adjustment or a public reference, cost per kilometre is not calculated for this fuel.
fuelPrices.referenceMissing: There is no published public reference for this fuel yet.
fuelPrices.error: Could not save the price. Code: {{code}}.
fuelPrices.tariff: {{distributor}} tariff: TUSD {{tusd}} + TE {{te}} per MWh, in force from {{from}} to {{to}}.
fuelPrices.tariffMissing: There is no published tariff for the chosen distributor yet.
fuelPrices.taxFree: The approved tariff is dry: no ICMS, no PIS/COFINS and no flag surcharge. Adjust the price here to reach what the electricity bill charges.

energySettings.title: Electricity
energySettings.hint: The kilowatt-hour price of an electric vehicle comes from the ANEEL tariff of the distributor chosen here, multiplied by the adjustment factor.
energySettings.factorHint: The published tariff is dry: no taxes and no tariff flag. The factor multiplies it up to what the electricity bill charges — 1.0000 keeps the tariff as published.
energySettings.error: The distributor could not be saved. Code: {{code}}.
energySettings.loadError: The energy settings could not be loaded.
energySettings.emptyCatalog: No tariff has been published yet: the ANEEL collection runs once a week and it is what fills this list.
energySettings.unchosen: Without a chosen distributor, the R$/km of an electric vehicle is not calculated.

vehicleSelection.selectAll: Select every vehicle in the list

regionCities.hint: Pick from the IBGE list or paste the spreadsheet column. Both doors store the IBGE spelling.
regionCities.listUnavailable: The IBGE list did not answer. Paste the names below — they are stored with the spelling you type.
regionCities.pasteHint: One city per line, or separated by comma or semicolon.
regionCities.stateFirst: Pick the state first: a city name is unique only within a state.
regionCities.unmatchedHint: These names matched no IBGE row and were not stored. Check the spelling or pick from the list.

regionForm.codeHint: Family and zone, such as 1.000 for the family 1 matrix and 1.002 for zone 3.
regionForm.codeInvalid: The route code is out of the expected format
regionForm.codeTaken: A route with this code already exists

error.city_duplicated: The same city appears twice in this route
error.code_invalid: The code must follow family.00zone, such as 1.002

regionForm.name: Route name
regionForm.rateHint: Leave the class blank when it does not serve the route — a zeroed amount says the same and is not stored.
regionForm.rateLegend: Amount paid to the driver by class

blocked.rates_required: Pick the rates file too: without it the import cannot tell what the driver is paid.
blocked.regions_required: Pick the routes file. It is what says which routes and cities exist.

regionImport.failed: The import did not go through. Check the columns of both files and try again.
regionImport.hint: Both files go up together: the routes file says which routes and cities exist, the rates file says what each class is paid. A route missing from the file is deactivated, never deleted.
regionImport.ratesHint: One row per route, with one column per vehicle class.
regionImport.regionsHint: One row per city, with the route code, the region name and the state.
regionImport.title: Import the freight table

regionMap.empty: Pick a state to draw the map of its routes.
regionMap.failed: The IBGE mesh did not answer. The table is still complete — only the drawing is missing.
regionMap.hint: Every municipality is painted by the zone of the route claiming it. A city claimed by two routes is painted by the first and named by all of them on hover.
regionMap.outsideHint: These names are on the table but matched no municipality of the chosen state. They may belong to another state or be misspelled.
regionMap.title: Route map

regionSelection.selectAll: Select every route on the list

regions.emptyHint: Register the first zone through the form or bring the whole table in through the import.
regions.hint: Each class amount is what the carrier pays the driver for the trip — it is not the price charged to the customer.
regions.title: Regions and amounts

ownerIncompleteHint: The driver record has no {{fields}} — the MDF-e owner group requires these fields. Complete the record right here, without leaving the vehicle form.
ownerIncompleteUnknownDriver: The owner document matches no registered driver — pick the driver in the list above to complete the record.
ownerIncompleteFeedback: The owner driver record is incomplete: complete it before saving the vehicle.
